meaning:
ἄπ-ειμι
(εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;]
to be absent: 1Co.5:3, 2Co.10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Php.1:27, Col.2:5.†
(AS)
glosses: am absent from you in body

renderings.bsb: am absent from you in body

elsewhere.note: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in…
For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
